CustomField.description: Payer name as it appears in the bank's UPI credit alert (e.g. VIKRAM K). Learned from the first matched payment; used to match later payments even when amounts collide.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Name shown in the Axis credit alert when this client pays by UPI. Filled in automatically after the first matched payment; edit if it changes.
CustomField.label: UPI Payer Name
